records.loginProcess: 1) Mandatory File Login through Lead Force LLPS App. 2) Punch in customer details and branch details in LeadForce App and generate Lead ID. 3) Complete Physical File and mention Lead ID on the file and submit the same to RAPC/Branch. 4) Branch/RAPC will evaluate file approval feasibility with CIBIL Check, ROI applicability and property eligibility and generate IP approval. 5) Post IP approval, Link is sent to customer for payment of Login Fees. 6) Post Login fees payment, Legal + Technical is initiated and physical file is processed further for final sanction. 7) After Stamp Duty+ Registration is completed final sanction is generated. 8) Post Final sanction, Customer has to visit the allocated branch and submit original documents and pay stamp paper charges, NOI, Mortgage charges and Insurance premium and sign the loan agreement. Loan Account and Savings account is created for EMI deduction at this stage. 9) Post final documents submission and loan agreeement signing, amount is transferred to seller through RTGS if selles is developer. If property is resell then fund transfer can be done either through pay order or RTGS as per requirement.
